name: ollametry
description: Ollama metrics exporter for Prometheus and OpenTelemetry: a transparent proxy measuring tokens, time to first token, decode speed, errors and loaded models per model.
description_good_justification: The README states what ollametry does, how it works and which APIs it measures: https://github.com/a1exus/ollametry#readme
interact_justification: The README links installation (docs/install.md), feedback through GitHub issues, and contributing (CONTRIBUTING.md).
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md lists the requirements: tests at the right layer, CHANGELOG entry, make check passing, commit style; the pull request template repeats them as a checklist.
documentation_basics_justification: README plus docs/ (install, containers, clients, metrics, prometheus, configuration, operations, development, releases).
documentation_interface_justification: Inputs: docs/configuration.md (every flag and variable). Outputs: docs/metrics.md (every metric and attribute), docs/prometheus.md, and api/openapi.yaml (OpenAPI 3.1 for the admin endpoints, contract-tested).
sites_https_justification: The project is served from github.com and images from ghcr.io, both HTTPS only.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues: searchable, each with its own URL, open to anyone with a GitHub account.
english_justification: Documentation is in English, and issues are accepted in English.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained; see the commit history and Dependabot updates.
repo_track_justification: Git records every change, its author and its time; changes land through pull requests.
repo_interim_justification: All work happens in the public repository; every merged pull request is visible between releases.
version_unique_justification: Releases are tagged vX.Y.Z; the binary reports its version (ollametry version).
version_semver_justification: Semantic Versioning, with a Keep a Changelog CHANGELOG.md.
version_tags_justification: Releases are created by pushing a vX.Y.Z tag (docs/releases.md).
release_notes_justification: No release yet. The release workflow turns the version's CHANGELOG.md section (Keep a Changelog) into the release notes and fails if it is missing.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No release yet. CHANGELOG.md has a Security section that names fixed vulnerabilities (for example GO-2026-6860, GO-2026-6866).
report_process_justification: GitHub issues with bug report and feature request forms.
report_responses_justification: No bug reports have been filed yet; issues are answered by the maintainer (@a1exus).
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement requests have been filed yet; they are answered by the maintainer (@a1exus).
report_archive_justification: GitHub issues are public and searchable: https://github.com/a1exus/ollametry/issues
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled and documented in SECURITY.md.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports received. SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging reports within a week.
build_justification: make build (container image), make dist (release archives), or go build ./cmd/ollametry.
build_floss_tools_justification: Builds with FLOSS tools only (Go, make, Docker Engine).
test_justification: Unit, integration and end-to-end tests, documented in docs/development.md#testing; run with make test or go test.
test_most_justification: About 88% statement coverage (make cover), plus fuzzing of the parsers and promtool unit tests for the alert rules.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs lint, unit and integration tests on Linux, macOS and Windows for every pull request; a ruleset requires them to pass.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires tests at the right layer for every change.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent pull requests add tests with their changes (for example the OpenAPI contract test, allocation guard, and Prometheus rule tests).
tests_documented_added_justification: The pull request template and CONTRIBUTING.md ask for tests.
warnings_justification: go vet and golangci-lint (including gosec, errorlint, staticcheck) run on every pull request.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails on any lint finding; the code has none.
warnings_strict_justification: golangci-lint runs with a strict configuration (.golangci.yml) and zero tolerated findings.
crypto_published_justification: ollametry implements no cryptography. An https upstream URL uses Go's standard crypto/tls.
crypto_random_justification: ollametry generates no keys or nonces.
delivery_mitm_justification: Releases and images are delivered over HTTPS (GitHub, ghcr.io) with SHA256SUMS and Sigstore-signed build provenance attestations.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Checksums are only published over HTTPS, next to signed attestations (gh attestation verify).
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: govulncheck runs on every pull request and finds none; Dependabot security updates are enabled.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: Security updates bypass the dependency cooldown, and vulnerable modules are upgraded as soon as a fix exists.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The repository contains no credentials; secret scanning and push protection are enabled.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (security-and-quality), golangci-lint with gosec, govulncheck, actionlint and zizmor run on every pull request.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL security queries and gosec look for common vulnerabilities; zizmor checks the GitHub Actions workflows.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Code scanning alerts are triaged promptly: fixed, or dismissed as false positives with a test as evidence.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every pull request and push to main; CodeQL also weekly.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Go native fuzzing of the parsers runs nightly; tests run with the race detector.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Go is memory-safe and the code does not use package unsafe.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests and fuzz targets assert invariants (chunking independence, bounded attributes) and run with -race.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Fuzzing findings are fixed and their inputs kept as regression tests (for example the model key resolution fix).
